title: Federated Harbor — author-side claim template
description: Every consequential claim a drafter ships uses this shape. The redteam matches on these fields; missing fields are sloppy drafting.

section.description: The Federated Harbor section key. Always `§fh-N` to disambiguate from Anchor/Bonded `§N`.

claim.description: One falsifiable sentence. No `we believe`, no `arguably`. Names conditions or names what would refute it.

proof_sketch.description: Body proof sketch, ≤ 1/2 page. Full proof to appendix. Empty string is allowed only if the claim is an analogy or definition.

path.description: Method-specific formal or empirical path. A PENDING path remains a plan until the source, receipt, and manifest record land.

kind.description: Mechanization tool. See references/computational-tooling.md (inherited from redteam-review).

status.description: PENDING = placeholder, LANDED = artifact runs with RESULT true, FAILING = artifact exists but counterexample found (must trigger redteam round).

falsification.description: Named scenario that would knock the claim down. `unless [partition longer than D]` style, never `unless something bad happens`.

class.description: Which kind of scope hedge. `threat-model` requires naming what is no longer defended.

narrows.description: What the hedge removes. Empty is unacceptable for class=threat-model.

happy_path.description: Path to TikZ/PDF for happy-path figure.

adversarial.description: Path to facing-page adversarial figure if the prose describes ≥3 hops / ≥2 domains / ≥1 adversarial branch.

figure.description: Per the SKILL.md decision tree. New primitive or trade-off or theorem requires a figure.

sidenotes.description: 4-6 Tufte sidenotes per major section. Enforced by the educational-density rule.

cross_paper.description: Cross-paper dependencies in canonical substitution form.

source.description: Source paper and section. Use the placeholder form `anchor §[ANCHOR-§-NAME]` if Anchor section numbers are still moving.

substitution.description: Canonical substitution form: `[orig → fed, orig → fed, ...]`. Prose paraphrases are incomplete.

placeholders.description: Named placeholders this claim depends on. Must be listed so proof-completer can pin them.

mechanization_pending_until.description: If artifact.status = PENDING, the round by which it must land. Survives at most one round.
